sections.heading: Eleos Health vs Freed: Overview
sections.content: Eleos Health and Freed serve different markets in the AI documentation space. Eleos Health, with $120M+ in funding, is the 'System of Action' for community-based behavioral health care - going beyond scribing to automate eligibility verification, compliance, and clinical insights specifically for behavioral health organizations. Freed, backed by General Catalyst and Sequoia, is an accessible AI scribe starting at $39/month that works across medical specialties including mental health. Eleos is enterprise-focused with proven clinical outcomes; Freed is democratizing AI documentation with affordable pricing.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: The pricing models are fundamentally different. Freed offers transparent pricing: Starter at $39/month (40 notes), Core at $79/month (unlimited notes), and Premier at $119/month (EHR push, ICD-10). Eleos Health requires custom enterprise contracts without public pricing - typical for tools targeting CMHCs and larger behavioral health organizations. For solo practitioners and small practices, Freed is the only affordable option. For enterprise behavioral health, Eleos's comprehensive platform may provide better ROI.

sections.heading: Behavioral Health vs General Purpose
sections.content: Eleos Health is purpose-built for behavioral health with the Polaris AI platform that understands psychiatric documentation, session types from psychiatry to case management, and behavioral health compliance requirements. The platform includes eligibility verification (Verify), outreach automation, and has proven outcomes: 70%+ documentation reduction, 2x client engagement boost, and 3-4x symptom improvement. Freed is a versatile AI scribe that works well for mental health but serves all specialties without behavioral health-specific automation.

sections.heading: Scale & Enterprise Features
sections.content: Eleos Health supports 150+ languages with mobile offline documentation for field-based care - critical for community mental health and home health settings. The platform has HITRUST and SOC 2 Type II certifications plus ISO 27001/27799/42001 for enterprise security. Freed offers simpler compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA) and integrates with a broader range of EHRs via browser extension. Eleos integrates natively with behavioral health EHRs like Kipu, SmartCare, and Welligent.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?

faqs.q: Is Eleos Health only for behavioral health?
faqs.a: Yes, Eleos Health is purpose-built for behavioral health including psychiatry, therapy, case management, substance abuse treatment, and community mental health. Freed works across all medical specialties including mental health.

faqs.q: How much does Eleos Health cost?
faqs.a: Eleos Health uses custom enterprise pricing and does not publish rates. The platform targets mid-size to large behavioral health organizations. Contact Eleos for a quote based on your organization size and needs.

faqs.q: Can Freed work for therapists and mental health practices?
faqs.a: Yes, Freed supports psychiatry and mental health documentation including therapy progress notes, psychiatric evaluations, and SOAP notes. However, it's a general AI scribe rather than behavioral health-specific like Eleos.
Yes, Eleos introduced mobile offline documentation in 2025 for field-based and rural care settings. Notes sync automatically when connectivity is restored. Freed requires internet connectivity.
